update clqfg_conversations c
set message_count = (
  select count(*) from clqfg_messages m
  where m.tenant = c.tenant

do $$
declare
  t text;
begin
  foreach t in array array[
    'clqfg_profiles',
    'clqfg_follows',

    'clqfg_likes',

    'clqfg_reactions',
    'clqfg_receipts',
    'clqfg_poll_options',
    'clqfg_poll_votes'
  ]
  loop
    begin
      execute format('alter table %I replica identity full', t);
      execute format('alter publication supabase_realtime add table %I', t);
    exception when duplicate_object then
      null;
    when undefined_object then
      null;
    end;
  end loop;
end $$

-- ---------- feed RPC (keyset, 20/page default) ----------
-- returns originals + reposts in one reverse-chron stream
create or replace function {{P}}feed(viewer uuid, tab text, before_ts timestamptz, before_id text, lim int)
returns table (
  entry_id text, is_repost boolean, sort_ts timestamptz, sort_key text,
  post_id text, author_id uuid, body varchar(500), kind text, media text[],
  parent_id text, created_at timestamptz, like_count int, repost_count int, reply_count int,
  author_handle text, author_name text, author_avatar text,
  liked boolean, reposted boolean,
  reposted_by uuid, reposted_by_name text, reposted_by_handle text, reposted_at timestamptz
) language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  with scope as (
    select f.followee_id as who from {{P}}follows f where f.follower_id = viewer
    union select viewer
  ),
  orig as (
    select ('p:'||p.id)::text entry_id, false is_repost, p.created_at sort_ts,
      ('p:'||p.id) sort_key, p.id post_id, p.author_id, p.body, p.kind, p.media,
      p.parent_id, p.created_at, p.like_count, p.repost_count, p.reply_count,
      null::uuid reposted_by, null::timestamptz reposted_at
    from {{P}}posts p
    where p.parent_id is null
      and (tab = 'global' or p.author_id in (select who from scope))
  ),
  repo as (
    select ('r:'||r.user_id::text||':'||r.post_id)::text entry_id, true is_repost, r.created_at sort_ts,
      ('r:'||r.user_id::text||':'||r.post_id) sort_key, p.id post_id, p.author_id, p.body, p.kind, p.media,
      p.parent_id, p.created_at, p.like_count, p.repost_count, p.reply_count,
      r.user_id reposted_by, r.created_at reposted_at
    from {{P}}reposts r join {{P}}posts p on p.id = r.post_id
    where p.parent_id is null
      and (tab = 'global' or r.user_id in (select who from scope))
  ),
  -- Contract: an original and each qualifying repost surface as SEPARATE
  -- cards (repost-toggle-live-attribution requires the count to grow; the
  -- follow-edge projection requires a direct card alongside a viewer repost).
  stream as (select * from orig union all select * from repo)
  select s.entry_id, s.is_repost, s.sort_ts, s.sort_key,
    s.post_id, s.author_id, s.body, s.kind, s.media, s.parent_id, s.created_at,
    s.like_count, s.repost_count, s.reply_count,
    ap.handle author_handle, ap.display_name author_name, ap.avatar_path author_avatar,
    exists (select 1 from {{P}}likes l where l.post_id = s.post_id and l.user_id = viewer) liked,
    exists (select 1 from {{P}}reposts rr where rr.post_id = s.post_id and rr.user_id = viewer) reposted,
    s.reposted_by,
    rp.display_name reposted_by_name, rp.handle reposted_by_handle, s.reposted_at
  from stream s
  join {{P}}profiles ap on ap.user_id = s.author_id
  left join {{P}}profiles rp on rp.user_id = s.reposted_by
  where (before_ts is null or s.sort_ts < before_ts
      or (s.sort_ts = before_ts and s.sort_key < before_id))
  order by s.sort_ts desc, s.sort_key desc
  limit lim;
$$

-- ---------- thread RPC ----------
create or replace function {{P}}thread(viewer uuid, root text)
returns table (
  post_id text, author_id uuid, body varchar(500), kind text, media text[],
  parent_id text, created_at timestamptz, like_count int, repost_count int, reply_count int,
  author_handle text, author_name text, author_avatar text,
  liked boolean, reposted boolean
) language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select p.id, p.author_id, p.body, p.kind, p.media, p.parent_id, p.created_at,
    p.like_count, p.repost_count, p.reply_count,
    ap.handle, ap.display_name, ap.avatar_path,
    exists (select 1 from {{P}}likes l where l.post_id = p.id and l.user_id = viewer),
    exists (select 1 from {{P}}reposts rr where rr.post_id = p.id and rr.user_id = viewer)
  from {{P}}posts p join {{P}}profiles ap on ap.user_id = p.author_id
  where p.id = root or p.parent_id = root
  order by case when p.id = root then 0 else 1 end, p.created_at asc, p.id asc;
$$

-- ---------- conversation list RPC ----------
create or replace function {{P}}convo_list(viewer uuid)
returns table (
  convo_id text, kind text, name text, description text, color text,
  background_path text, disappearing text, created_at timestamptz,
  other_user_id uuid, other_handle text, other_name text, other_avatar text,
  member_count int, last_body text, last_kind text, last_sender uuid,
  last_created timestamptz, last_id text, unread int
) language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select c.id, c.kind, c.name, c.description, c.color, c.background_path,
    c.disappearing, c.created_at,
    o.user_id, op.handle, op.display_name, op.avatar_path,
    (select count(*)::int from {{P}}members m2 where m2.conversation_id = c.id and m2.left_at is null),
    lm.body, lm.kind, lm.sender_id, lm.created_at, lm.id,
    (select count(*)::int from {{P}}messages m3

create function {{P}}history(viewer uuid, convo text, before_ts timestamptz, before_id text, lim int)
returns table (
  id text, conversation_id text, sender_id uuid, kind text, body text,
  media_path text, view_once boolean, quote_id text, edited boolean,
  deleted boolean, expires_at timestamptz, purged boolean,
  created_at timestamptz, sender_handle text, sender_name text,
  sender_avatar text, quote_body text, quote_sender_name text,
  reactions jsonb, my_reaction text, receipt text, viewed boolean
) language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
begin
  if not {{P}}ever_member(convo, viewer) then
    raise exception 'CLQFM_NOT_A_MEMBER';
  end if;
  return query
  select m.id, m.conversation_id, m.sender_id, m.kind,
    case when m.deleted then '' else m.body end,
    case when m.deleted then '' else m.media_path end,
    m.view_once, m.quote_id, m.edited, m.deleted, m.expires_at, m.purged, m.created_at,
    sp.handle, sp.display_name::text, sp.avatar_path,
    (case when qm.deleted then '' else qm.body end), qp.display_name::text,
    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('emoji', g.emoji, 'count', g.cnt,
        'mine', exists (select 1 from {{P}}reactions r2
          where r2.message_id = m.id and r2.user_id = viewer and r2.emoji = g.emoji)))
      from (select r.emoji, count(*) cnt from {{P}}reactions r
            where r.message_id = m.id group by r.emoji) g), '[]'::jsonb),
    (select r.emoji from {{P}}reactions r where r.message_id = m.id and r.user_id = viewer limit 1),
    (select case when count(*) = 0 then 'sent'
      when bool_and(r.state = 'read') then 'read'
      when bool_and(r.state in ('delivered','read')) then 'delivered'
      else 'sent' end
     from {{P}}receipts r where r.message_id = m.id),
    exists (select 1 from {{P}}viewonce_views v
      where v.message_id = m.id and v.user_id = viewer)
  from {{P}}messages m
  join {{P}}profiles sp on sp.user_id = m.sender_id
  left join {{P}}messages qm on qm.id = m.quote_id
  left join {{P}}profiles qp on qp.user_id = qm.sender_id
  where m.conversation_id = convo and not m.purged
    and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
    and (before_ts is null or m.created_at < before_ts
      or (m.created_at = before_ts and m.id < before_id))
  order by m.created_at desc, m.id desc
  limit lim;
end $$

    (select count(*)::int from {{P}}follows f where f.followee_id = viewer),
    (select count(*)::int from {{P}}follows f where f.follower_id = viewer);
$$

create or replace function {{P}}insights_daily(viewer uuid)
returns table (day date, posts int, likes int)
language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  with days as (
    select (date_trunc('day', now()) - (s || ' days')::interval)::date d from generate_series(6,0,-1) s
  )
  select dd.d,
    (select count(*)::int from {{P}}posts p where p.author_id = viewer and p.parent_id is null
       and p.created_at >= dd.d and p.created_at < dd.d + 1),
    (select count(*)::int from {{P}}likes l join {{P}}posts p on p.id = l.post_id
       where p.author_id = viewer and p.parent_id is null
         and l.created_at >= dd.d and l.created_at < dd.d + 1)
  from days dd order by dd.d;
$$

create or replace function {{P}}trending()
returns table (
  post_id text, author_id uuid, body varchar(500), kind text, media text[],
  created_at timestamptz, like_count int, repost_count int, reply_count int,
  author_handle text, author_name text, author_avatar text
) language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select p.id, p.author_id, p.body, p.kind, p.media, p.created_at,
    p.like_count, p.repost_count, p.reply_count, ap.handle, ap.display_name, ap.avatar_path
  from {{P}}posts p join {{P}}profiles ap on ap.user_id = p.author_id
  where p.parent_id is null and p.created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
  order by p.like_count desc, p.created_at desc, p.id desc
  limit 10;
$$

-- Durable idempotency ledger: every applied vote intent's client mutation id
-- is recorded forever. A retried/stale intent (same mutation id, even one
-- superseded by a newer intent) resolves to current state without writing,
-- so at-least-once delivery and offline-queue retry can never flip state.

  mutation_id text primary key,
  message_id text not null references {{P}}messages(id) on delete cascade,
  user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
)

-- No direct-access policies: the app records intents through vote_poll only
-- (SECURITY DEFINER); direct table access stays denied.

-- ============ 1b. widen messages.kind to admit polls ============
-- The pre-M7 check constraint carries an auto-generated name, so drop by
-- definition match (kind IN-list mentioning video), then re-add explicitly.

do $$
declare r record;
begin
  for r in select conname from pg_constraint
    where conrelid = '{{P}}messages'::regclass and contype = 'c'
      and pg_get_constraintdef(oid) ilike '%kind%in%video%' loop
    execute format('alter table {{P}}messages drop constraint %I', r.conname);
  end loop;
end $$

create function {{P}}history(viewer uuid, convo text, before_ts timestamptz, before_id text, lim int)
returns table (
  id text, conversation_id text, sender_id uuid, kind text, body text,
  media_path text, view_once boolean, quote_id text, edited boolean,
  deleted boolean, expires_at timestamptz, purged boolean,
  created_at timestamptz, sender_handle text, sender_name text,
  sender_avatar text, quote_body text, quote_sender_name text,
  reactions jsonb, my_reaction text, receipt text, viewed boolean,
  poll jsonb
) language plpgsql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
begin
  if not {{P}}ever_member(convo, viewer) then
    raise exception 'CLQFM_NOT_A_MEMBER';
  end if;
  return query
  select m.id, m.conversation_id, m.sender_id, m.kind,
    case when m.deleted then '' else m.body end,
    case when m.deleted then '' else m.media_path end,
    m.view_once, m.quote_id, m.edited, m.deleted, m.expires_at, m.purged, m.created_at,
    sp.handle, sp.display_name::text, sp.avatar_path,
    (case when qm.deleted then '' else qm.body end), qp.display_name::text,
    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('emoji', g.emoji, 'count', g.cnt,
        'mine', exists (select 1 from {{P}}reactions r2
          where r2.message_id = m.id and r2.user_id = viewer and r2.emoji = g.emoji)))
      from (select r.emoji, count(*) cnt from {{P}}reactions r
            where r.message_id = m.id group by r.emoji) g), '[]'::jsonb),
    (select r.emoji from {{P}}reactions r where r.message_id = m.id and r.user_id = viewer limit 1),
    (select case when count(*) = 0 then 'sent'
      when bool_and(r.state = 'read') then 'read'
      when bool_and(r.state in ('delivered','read')) then 'delivered'
      else 'sent' end
     from {{P}}receipts r where r.message_id = m.id),
    exists (select 1 from {{P}}viewonce_views v
      where v.message_id = m.id and v.user_id = viewer),
    case when m.kind = 'poll' then {{P}}poll_state(viewer, m.id) else null end
  from {{P}}messages m
  join {{P}}profiles sp on sp.user_id = m.sender_id
  left join {{P}}messages qm on qm.id = m.quote_id
  left join {{P}}profiles qp on qp.user_id = qm.sender_id
  where m.conversation_id = convo and not m.purged
    and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
    and (before_ts is null or m.created_at < before_ts
      or (m.created_at = before_ts and m.id < before_id))
  order by m.created_at desc, m.id desc
  limit lim;
end $$

    (select r.emoji from {{P}}reactions r where r.message_id = m.id and r.user_id = viewer limit 1),
    (select case when count(*) = 0 then 'sent'
      when bool_and(r.state = 'read') then 'read'
      when bool_and(r.state in ('delivered','read')) then 'delivered'

  left join {{P}}messages qm on qm.id = m.quote_id

  where m.conversation_id = convo and not m.purged

    and (before_ts is null or m.created_at < before_ts

  order by m.created_at desc, m.id desc

create or replace function {{P}}convo_list(viewer uuid)
returns table (
  convo_id text, kind text, name text, description text, color text,
  background_path text, disappearing text, created_at timestamptz,
  other_user_id uuid, other_handle text, other_name text, other_avatar text,
  member_count int, last_body text, last_kind text, last_sender uuid,
  last_created timestamptz, last_id text, unread int, message_count int
) language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select c.id, c.kind, c.name, c.description, c.color, c.background_path,
    c.disappearing, c.created_at,
    o.user_id, op.handle, op.display_name, op.avatar_path,
    (select count(*)::int from {{P}}members m2 where m2.conversation_id = c.id and m2.left_at is null),
    lm.body, lm.kind, lm.sender_id, lm.created_at, lm.id,
    (select count(*)::int from {{P}}messages m3
       where m3.conversation_id = c.id and m3.sender_id <> viewer
         and not m3.deleted and not m3.purged
         and (m3.expires_at is null or m3.expires_at > now())
         and not exists (select 1 from {{P}}receipts r
           where r.message_id = m3.id and r.user_id = viewer and r.state = 'read')),
    c.message_count
  from {{P}}conversations c
  join {{P}}members me on me.conversation_id = c.id and me.user_id = viewer and me.left_at is null
  left join {{P}}members o on o.conversation_id = c.id and o.user_id <> viewer and o.left_at is null and c.kind = 'dm'
  left join {{P}}profiles op on op.user_id = o.user_id
  left join lateral (
    select m.body, m.kind, m.sender_id, m.created_at, m.id from {{P}}messages m
    where m.conversation_id = c.id and not m.purged
      and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
    order by m.created_at desc, m.id desc limit 1
  ) lm on true
  order by lm.created_at desc nulls last, c.created_at desc;
$$
